## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 用户级 LEFT JOIN：将 user tag 关联到指标表
-- 典型场景：AB 实验效果分析
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        grass_date,
        grass_region,
        user_id,
        CASE WHEN group_name = 'control' THEN 'control'
             WHEN group_name = 'mp_plus_ads' THEN 'mp_plus_ads'
             ELSE 'other'
        END AS exp_group_id
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_smart_voucher_blacklist_user
    WHERE grass_date >= date '${date1}'
      AND grass_date <= date '${date2}'
      AND grass_region IN ('${region}')
) B ON A.grass_region = B.grass_region
   AND A.grass_date = B.grass_date
   AND A.user_id = B.user_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. AB 实验分析 — 用户分群关联（globalcontrol 文件）

```sql
user_tag AS (
    SELECT A.grass_region, A.grass_date, A.user_id,
           CASE
               WHEN A.exp_group_id = 'control' THEN 'control'
               WHEN A.exp_group_id = 'mp_plus_ads' AND B.exp_group_id = 'ads_base'
                    THEN 'mp_plus_ads & ads_base'
               WHEN A.exp_group_id = 'mp_plus_ads' AND B.exp_group_id = 'ads_exp'
                    THEN 'mp_plus_ads & ads_exp'
               ELSE 'other'
           END AS exp_group_id
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, user_id,
               CASE WHEN group_name = 'control' THEN 'control'
                    WHEN group_name = 'mp_plus_ads' THEN 'mp_plus_ads'
                    ELSE 'other' END AS exp_group_id
        FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_smart_voucher_blacklist_user
        WHERE grass_date >= date '${date1}'
          AND grass_date <= date '${date2}'
          AND grass_region IN ('${region}')
    ) A
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT grass_region, local_date, user_id,
               CASE WHEN exp_group_id IN (656430,656431) THEN 'ads_base'
                    WHEN exp_group_id BETWEEN 656432 AND 656440 THEN 'ads_exp'
                    ELSE 'others' END AS exp_group_id
        FROM srdi_mart.dim_sr_data_warehouse_abtest_user_group
        WHERE grass_region IN ('${region}')
          AND project_name = 'Ads'
          AND scene_id = 1361 AND layer_id = 138080
    ) B ON A.grass_region = B.grass_region
       AND A.grass_date = B.local_date
       AND A.user_id = B.user_id
)
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### 写入方式

所有写入均使用 `INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ... PARTITION (grass_date, grass_region)` 动态分区覆写模式。
前置设置：`SET spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode = dynamic;`

### 按区域的上游表

### 写入策略

- 各区域独立 workflow 写入对应 partition
- 每批写入覆盖未来 1-3 天分区（T+1, T+2, T+3），预先填充未来数据
- 多条写入路径写入同一表的不同 `grass_region` partition，互不冲突
- SG 区域有 BAU 和 Campaign 两套上游（按日期不同切换）
